workflow_lessons: At this scale, API/server-side rate limits became the binding constraint, not token budget.
Do one large find/verify/patch workflow at a time; running three or more large workflows concurrently tripped throttling and wasted agents.
OCR/source crops are witness and localization layers; the corrected TeX remains workpass until page-by-page source audit closes.

Live serial audit can overtake a packaged support ZIP within hours, so SGA support packets should be repackaged only at stable milestones and described as snapshots rather than current canonical text.
caveats: Not complete SGA5, not a critical edition, and not a promoted reader-facing replacement for the SGA record.
The package contains workpass/audit evidence and a corrected TeX copy; canonical promotion requires diff review, reruns of rate-limited pages, final pdflatex gate, and page-by-page closure.
Existing SGA5 public metadata must continue to state working draft with significant remaining source errors.
